text:
alex: Quick QA pass on the release notes for tonight's change window (00:30 UTC). Also need a short evacuation lane in the RN — can someone eyeball the bullets? cc @mira @sam

deploy-bot: [automated] Deploy cue created: release/2024-09-20. Canary schedule: 00:30Z -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Use /deploy rollback if canary fails. See /ops/deploys for details.

mira: I can do copy QA in 20m. Will report any microcopy nits.

sam: I'm on-call for that window, I'll monitor metrics and carry the pager. ping me if canary looks off.

jorge: Ops note: we should pin inference runtime to rdx-large@v2.4.1 for this rollout — avoids the new quantization kernel that landed yesterday. Otherwise we risk mem regressions.

elaine: Suggest explicit rollback criteria in the RN: p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m OR error rate > 2% sustained for 3m. Also add fallback lane to smaller model in us-west to keep latency SLOs.

alex: good call — adding bullets now. Here's the RN snippet I'm proposing (please copy/paste comments inline):

```
- Release: 2024-09-20 - inference runtime and kv-cache stability
- Fix: reduce kv-cache eviction thrash to lower memory pressure under heavy prefix reuse
- Change: default model pinned to rdx-large@v2.4.1 for stable kernel behavior
- Deployment: Canary rollout @ 00:30 UTC (5% -> 25% -> 100%), monitor p95 latency and error rate
- Rollback criteria: p95 > 2x baseline for 5m OR errors > 2% for 3m -> trigger /deploy rollback
- Evacuation lane: if regional latency spikes, route traffic to fallback region (policy: failover-us-west)
- Ops: on-call will run quick rollback and pinback if criteria met; see /ops/runbooks/canary-rollback.md
```

mira: tiny nit: change 'reduce kv-cache eviction thrash' -> 'reduce kv-cache eviction churn' to be precise. Also add short why: reduces OOMs for long-chat workloads.

alex: updated snippet with 'churn' and added the why.

sam: Can we add the deploy-bot cue to RN text so ops knows where to look? e.g., "Deploy cue: release/2024-09-20 (deploy-bot)"

alex: added.

jorge: also adding model-pin command we should run if rollback needed: `rdxctl set-model-pin rdx-large@v2.3.9` — adding to ops bullets.

elaine: adding the rollback command and a short checklist:
- run `rdxctl set-model-pin ...`
- confirm canary metrics return to baseline
- notify customers via incident channel if >30m impact

sre-oncall: noted, I'll prepare the evacuation playbook and keep a quick script ready to flip route-policy -> failover-us-west. Will be watching the deploybot thread.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please tag the release note file with `release/2024-09-20` in /releases. If you want the deploy window adjusted, update the cue before 00:00 UTC.

product-ops: LGTM on copy from PM side. One ask: add a one-liner for customer communications so support has copy ready.

alex: added a single-sentence microcopy under 'Customer comms' -> "We deployed improvements to inference stability; no action required. Reach support if you see increased latency"

mira: ok from copy side, nothing blocking.

sam: Ops ready. I'll hold the pager and coordinate rollback if necessary.

alex: thanks everyone — locking RN at 00:00 UTC and creating the release file in /releases. Will post the final RN link here when created. :lock:

deploy-bot: [automated] Release file created: /releases/release-2024-09-20.md by alex. Canary scheduled for 00:30Z.

alex: final link: https://internal/repo/releases/release-2024-09-20.md — closing thread.
